science.qualification: Uniform photosphere color from the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)). No limb darkening is drawn: no mass is measured and no spectroscopic surface gravity is published with this radius: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770 assume the gravity of their fit (table column 15). The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting.

offLimbContext.source: none: no observation, a transparent plate

limbMaterial.composition: transparent: the sphere's own silhouette is the limb; the light just outside it is on the off-limb plate
